head: 66947304f0bd329a04f2fbd5e6a1acb8d97c91fa
scope: Delete semantics and live-row query closure for EF Core, FreeSql and SqlSugar on independent-file SQLite. T/U stay S3.

orm_providers.outcome: all D01-D09 delete/query cases and A01-A02 audit cases pass; all 124 historical tests pass; the 10 failures are the deferred S3 T/U red baselines

code_generator_full.outcome: running in the background at the time of this record; count is updated separately before the slice is reported complete

ef_core: both stamped id delete entries load the current row, apply the expected stamp as the original value, advance the stamp, and use tracked Deleted so AuditInterceptor performs the soft delete
stamped batch/predicate deletes throw NotSupportedException before any read or write
DbUpdateConcurrencyException at UoW flush is translated to CrestConcurrencyException
the tenant filter generator now emits strongly typed soft-delete filters; tenant+soft entities combine both conditions; guards make the generated registrations safe for multiple DbContexts
CrestCreatesDbContext applies soft-delete filters before tenant filters, including host context
CrestCreatesDbContext fails closed if a soft-delete entity remains without a query filter after generated registrations apply
free_sql: all five delete overloads use one provider-internal conditional UPDATE action for soft entities and keep DELETE for non-soft entities
stamped batch/predicate deletes reject before writes
repository construction registers the ISoftDelete global filter
GetQueryable throws NotSupportedException instead of returning ToList().AsQueryable()
SQL-level evidence test asserts the live-row condition appears in the database statement
sql_sugar: all five delete overloads use one provider-internal conditional UPDATE action for soft entities and keep DELETE for non-soft entities
stamped batch/predicate deletes reject before writes
repository queries add live-row conditions; audit wiring also registers the soft-delete filter
GetQueryable throws NotSupportedException instead of returning ToList().AsQueryable()
SQL-level evidence test asserts the live-row condition appears in the database statement

fault_controls.physical_delete_mutation: the S1 baselines at 2f3d64e4 ran against the old physical-DELETE implementations and failed D01/D03/D04/D08; after the S2 change the same cases pass
fault_controls.batch_stamp_zero_write: D08 asserts NotSupportedException and zero live rows changed
fault_controls.stale_stamp_zero_write: D06 EF/FreeSql/SqlSugar assert CrestConcurrencyException and an unchanged row
fault_controls.uow_delayed_conflict: U01_EfCore_stale_stamp_delete_reports_conflict_at_complete observes CrestConcurrencyException at CompleteAsync with the row unchanged
fault_controls.idempotent_delete: D04 changes the current user between deletes and asserts the first DeleterId is preserved

migration_notes.sdk_get_queryable: SDK repositories now throw NotSupportedException; use async repository methods or the SDK query API directly
migration_notes.stamped_batches: stamped batch/predicate deletes are rejected; use DeleteAsync(id, expectedStamp) per row
migration_notes.ef_filters: custom DbContexts must apply the generated soft-delete registration via SoftDeleteFilterConfiguration.ApplyAll; tenant filters remain via ConfigureTenantDiscriminator
migration_notes.sdk_repository_ctor: optional ICurrentUserProvider parameter; existing subclasses remain source-compatible; S3 wires the adapter

deferred_to_s3: persisted tenant ownership for detached writes and cross-tenant id/predicate deletes
per-operation tenant filters instead of configuration-time tenant capture
SqlSugar scoped client and ISqlSugarClient registration
cancellation source preservation and SDK token propagation
host tenant-visibility tightening with real consumers/migration notes
